name: DLinear
tagline: Decomposition-only linear forecaster: subtract a moving-average trend and learn one linear map per channel for trend and seasonal.
formula: $$ x_{\text{trend}} = \mathrm{AvgPool}_k(x),\quad x_{\text{season}} = x - x_{\text{trend}},\qquad \hat{x} = W_t\, x_{\text{trend}} + W_s\, x_{\text{season}} $$
diff_from_baseline: Zeng, Chen, Zhang & Xu 2023 (AAAI). Decomposition-then-Linear baseline: trend/seasonal split via moving average, then a per-channel linear map. Surprisingly competitive on long-horizon forecasting and a standard reference for time-series tasks; here repurposed for masked imputation in Time-Series-Library.

name: PatchTST
tagline: Channel-independent transformer over non-overlapping patches of each univariate series with RevIN normalization.
diff_from_baseline: Nie, Nguyen, Sinthong & Kalagnanam 2023 (ICLR). Patch-based, channel-independent transformer with RevIN; strong long-horizon forecaster used here through Time-Series-Library's imputation task hook.

name: TimesNet
tagline: FFT-derived top-k periods reshape the 1D series into 2D tensors; an Inception-style 2D CNN captures intra/inter-period patterns.
diff_from_baseline: Wu, Hu, Liu, Zhou, Wang & Long 2023 (ICLR). General-purpose temporal 2D-variation modelling: FFT picks dominant periods, the series is folded to 2D per period, and Inception-style 2D convolutions process intra- and inter-period structure. Standard imputation baseline in Time-Series-Library.
